prompt: Which query returns the product_name of every product that the promotion with promo_code 'P-2024-01' covers, one row per covered product? Any row order is fine.

options.text:
SELECT p.product_name
FROM promotions pr
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.promo_id
WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2024-01'

SELECT p.product_name
FROM promotions pr
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2024-01'

SELECT p.product_name
FROM promotions pr
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pr.promo_id
WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2024-01'

SELECT p.product_name
FROM promotions pr
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = pr.promo_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2024-01'
